## History

Gertie Pye was among the classmates who gave [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) a warm welcome when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned to school following a brief period of staying home. She also threw her slate pencil at [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during school.
